python3 - <<'PY'
import json,collections
fails=json.load(open('/tmp/ci/failures.json'))
cls={}
for line in open('/tmp/ci/hist.txt'):
    i,c=line.split()
    cls[i]=c
assert len(cls)==192, len(cls)
assert set(cls)=={f['id'] for f in fails}
owners=collections.defaultdict(lambda: collections.Counter())
for f in fails:
    owners[f['owner']][cls[f['id']]]+=1
out={"total":len(fails),
"owners":[{"owner":o,"new":owners[o]['new'],"persistent":owners[o]['persistent'],"intermittent":owners[o]['intermittent']} for o in sorted(owners)],
"slowest_new":[{"id":f['id'],"duration_ms":f['duration_ms']} for f in sorted([f for f in fails if cls[f['id']]=='new'],key=lambda x:(-x['duration_ms'],x['id']))[:5]]}
print(json.dumps(out))
print(sum(sum(c.values()) for c in owners.values()))
PY
